Sour Cream Sugar Cookies About ??? From the Kitchen of Heather Johnson From Issaquah 5th Ward
§ion;
We have had many really good recipes for sugar cookies. But this recipe is the best we have ever had.
Sugar2 Cups
ButterSoftened 1 Cup2 Sticks
Eggs3 Sour Cream1 Cup Vanilla1 teaspoon Baking Soda1 teaspoon Flour6½ Cups Salt1 teaspoon
ButterSoftened ½ Cup1 Stick
Cream Cheese1 8-oz. Package Vanilla1 teaspoon Powdered Sugar4 Cups
Food ColoringOptional A Few Drops
Milk as needed
Preheat oven to 350°. Cream Butter and Sugar together. Stir in Eggs. Stir in Sour Cream and Vanilla. Stir in the rest of the ingredients. Flatten dough between plastic wrap and refrigerate several hours until cold/hard. Roll dough to ¼&inch; thick, cut with cookie cutters and place on a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes. Let cool, then frost.
Combine Butter, Cream Cheese and Vanilla and beat until smooth. Gradually add Powdered Sugar while beating. If mixture is too thick to spread, add a small amount of Milk, ½ teaspoon at a time.
When a recipe says Softened Butter, it means butter at room temperature. Do NOT melt the Butter. It changes the consistency of the results to a sticky mess.
If you want to have plain white frosting, use colorless Vanilla.
